claims.text: For exactly these four cells, real CLI Generate selects koblitz-m3-native-v1, preserves original launch/capture and unique stored-root custody, completes the registered native profile, and dataset verify accepts supervisor-sealed manifests.

This same local run passes status/export/report checks with four source provenance/index rows and retained restricted Koblitz artifacts; exported static features exclude forbidden private/proof/outcome fields. Unique feature rows may be fewer than four because solvers share public inputs.

No general first/last fall-degree theorem, scaling law, comparative performance, complete instruction count, scientific corpus production, S3/cloud-verified cell, general causal representation, or complete corpus-axis coverage is established by these finite local software fixtures.

For the exact42 additional frozen cells, policy/version/cell mapping, public and restricted export, local content-addressed publication/restore, and source recipe identities are checked; all4 binary-policy-on-prime cells are explicit unsupported records. Wrong-recipe verify/restore controls reject before activation. Causal coverage requires nonempty prefix and algebraic rows, not merely empty successful exports.

Each of the unchanged four native Koblitz cells exports nonempty independently replayed signed-group prefix rows joined to its authenticated restricted source, with absent legacy policy identity and no restricted labels or seed fields in public rows.

invalidation_rules: Source/binary mismatch, dirty embedded provenance, stale validation gates, missing original binding, wrong adapter, missing/duplicate canonical artifacts, failed replay, expired/interrupted worker, or missing command receipt invalidates all-success.
Failure and timeout rows are retained and charged as attempts; no exclusion creates success. Unattempted remaining cells are explicitly reported.
Unavailable or multiplexed counters are preserved under actual scope; they cannot be promoted to complete hardware instruction measurements.
